accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard support for menus and forms

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Chivo' for all headings to give a technical, authoritative feel.
Use 'Inter' for body text to ensure high readability in data-dense tables.
Implement a 'Sidebar Layout' for the main application shell.
Use the 'Electric Blue' primary color for main actions (Create Ticket, Save).
Ensure all tables have sticky headers and hover effects on rows.
Use 'Badge' components for Ticket Status (Open, In Progress, Resolved).
Implement Dark Mode support using the 'dark' class strategy in Tailwind.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds in the main dashboard area; keep it clean and flat.
Use the provided image URLs for login screens and empty states.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts; prefer left-aligned, structured grids.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs for breathing room.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Do not use 'transition: all'; specify properties.
